From Tenore Sax · Price: the illusion breaks if a creature touches the walls to test them.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: make an illusion of a 10-ft corridor. Or 1 action: fold the corridor around a creature within 30 ft: walls that aren't there close in, @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}), and on a critical failure it's turned around, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn.
  • 5: Surge: each creature you choose in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-ft burst} within 30 ft is lost in the maze for 1 round (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates): it can only Stride in a direction you choose.
  • 9: Disbelieving takes a Recall Knowledge or Seek check vs your DC.
  • 13: The lost surge's range is 60 ft.
  • 17: 10 minutes: hold the maze as a lasting illusion over a whole building or a 60-ft area for 1 hour, with endless hallways and false rooms; touching a wall still breaks it for that creature only.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
